title: Once Upon a Farm Snacks at Costco
summary: Find Once Upon a Farm snacks for kids at select Costco clubs in the U.S. Availability and product assortment will vary by region.
body_markdown:
Once Upon a Farm is at Costco! Select Costco locations carry Once Upon a Farm snacks for a limited time, while others carry items on a year-round basis. We have a variety of organic kids' snacks at select Costco locations. Check below to see if your local warehouse is on the list.


**Note:** Costco generally carries items on a rotating basis. If we were previously at your Costco and no longer there, you may find us again in the future! Here's[our store locator](https://onceuponafarmorganics.com/pages/find-a-store) to find us at another retailer near you in the meantime! We're also available via subscription—delivered right to your door on your schedule.


**[BUILD A BOX](https://onceuponafarmorganics.com/pages/bundle-builder)**


## Tractor Wheels™ Soft-Baked Toddler Bars at Costco (20 Count)


- **2 flavors per box:** Apple, Sweet Potato & Spinach and Strawberry, Pumpkin & Beet


- **Available region(s):**


- Year Round


: Texas (+ AR, LA, OK), Midwest, Los Angeles (+ Hawaii), San Diego, Northwest
- Limited Time:


Bay Area, Northeast, Southeast (+ Puerto Rico)


## Immunity Blends at Costco (12 Count)


- **2 flavors per box:** Pineapple, Banana & Dragon Fruit and Mango, Banana & Spirulina (6 of each flavor)
- **Available region(s):**


- Year Round


: Los Angeles (+ Hawaii), Texas (+ AR, LA, OK), Midwest, San Diego, Bay Area, Northwest
- Limited Time


: Northeast, Southeast (+ Puerto Rico)
